MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show fits because its screen could add convenient Alexa controls and compatible camera viewing to my existing Fire TV and home-monitoring setup.",
    "The WYZE Cam v3 fits my interest in home security because color night vision offers a specific benefit, and I would consider it for a location with power available."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire TV Stick offers little immediate value because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television; the HD version adds even less to my setup.",
    "AirPods, car-based Alexa, and charging cables do not address a need shown in my recent purchases. I have no stated earbud or car-assistant need, and no confirmed device match for the cables.",
    "The tablet, Echo Dot, and WYZE Cam v2 relate to my interests, but I would skip them today because my existing screens cover much of the tablet's purpose, I prefer the Show's screen, and I would investigate the v3 first."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon or Alexa device, even when its purpose shifts from my home to my car.",
    "My interest in streaming and cameras seems to have been treated as a reason to buy more similar devices without considering what they would add to what I already own."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in an addition that serves a clear purpose, such as camera viewing on a smart display or better nighttime monitoring, than another device that repeats an existing function.",
    "A related product still needs a current use: camera placement and power availability matter, as do confirmed cable compatibility and whether I need another screen."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my home-video and security interests but stretch them too broadly into related gadgets and devices whose functions I already have."
}
